extracted.intended_audience: advertising and brand agencies, in-house marketing teams and creatives submitting work to the Cannes Lions Creative Strategy awards
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and judging criteria for entries to the Cannes Lions Creative Strategy competition, covering sector categorisation, research/insight themes, challenge/breakthrough categories, partnership criteria, and excellence-in-strategy categories. Includes eligibility windows, entry limits and recommended production practices for case films.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall purpose of Creative Strategy Lions
rubrics_metrics.description: The Creative Strategy Lions celebrate the idea behind the idea – how strategic planning can redefine a brand, reinvent its business, and influence consumers or wider culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The work should demonstrate exceptional interpretation of the business/brand challenge, breakthrough thinking and transformational problem solving that led to a compelling creative strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interpretation of business/brand challenge (30%)
rubrics_metrics.description: Interpretation of business/brand challenge.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Weighted as 30% of judging. Assessors will consider how clearly and insightfully the entry defines and interprets the underlying business or brand problem.

rubrics_metrics.name: Insight / breakthrough thinking (30%)
rubrics_metrics.description: Insight/breakthrough thinking.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Weighted as 30% of judging. Judges look for breakthrough strategic insights and original thinking that shift approach or perception.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creative idea (20%)
rubrics_metrics.description: Creative idea.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Weighted as 20% of judging. Evaluation focuses on the originality and execution of the creative idea derived from the strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcome / results (20%)
rubrics_metrics.description: Outcome/results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Weighted as 20% of judging. Judges assess the tangible impact, business results or cultural outcomes achieved by the strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility dates for Creative Strategy entries
rubrics_metrics.description: For Creative Strategy Lions the eligibility dates are 06 February 2023 - 09 April 2026 where the strategy being judged was first implemented within the eligibility period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries must have the strategy first implemented within this period to be eligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility exception for C04 Long-Term Strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Category 'C04 Long-term Strategy' has an eligibility period of 06 February 2021 - 09 April 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Long-term strategy entries have an increased eligibility window of 5 years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entry frequency limits
rubrics_metrics.description: The same piece of work can be entered up to four times in Creative Strategy. However, the same piece of work may only be entered once in 'A. Sectors'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You may submit the same work multiple times across Creative Strategy categories (up to four) but cannot submit the same piece more than once within the A (Sectors) section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subtitles on case films and original content
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtitles are highly recommended on all case films, films, demo films and original content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommendation aimed at ensuring accessibility and clarity in audiovisual submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: A01 Consumer Goods (sector guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: All fast-moving and durable consumer goods, including but not limited to food and beverages, toiletries, cleaning products, other household goods, other FMCGs, clothing and accessories, furniture, and consumer electronics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All fast-food entries should be entered into A04. Travel, Leisure, Retail, Restaurants & Fast-Food Chains.

rubrics_metrics.name: A02 Healthcare (sector guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Pharma, OTC drugs, wellness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the work has been created for a Charity/NFP then this should be entered into A07.

rubrics_metrics.name: A03 Automotive (sector guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Vehicles, other automobiles.

rubrics_metrics.name: A04 Travel, Leisure, Retail, Restaurants & Fast-Food Chains (sector guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: All transport- and travel-related services, including public transport and tourism boards. All entertainment- and leisure-related services, including museums, festivals and gyms. All shops, including online shopping, opticians, hairdressers and estate agents. All restaurants and fast food chains, including cafés and bars.

rubrics_metrics.name: A05 Media/Entertainment (sector guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Music, film, television, publications and media, books, news, digital platforms and other media.

rubrics_metrics.name: A06 Consumer Services/Business to Business (sector guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: All commercial public services, legal, financial, B2B technology, consultancies and professional services, other business services, internal and corporate communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: A07 Not-for-Profit / Charity / Government (sector guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Government, public information, NGOs, military, charities, non-profit organisations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the work has been created for a Charity/NFP then this should be entered into A07. All corporate social responsibility work should be entered in the relevant sector and/or C05 Corporate Purpose & Social Responsibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: B01 Data & Analytics (insights & research)
rubrics_metrics.description: Strategy inspired by insightful analysis and interpretation of data, revealing a clear business problem/opportunity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include but is not limited to the use of data science, commissioned research, online behavioural data, statistical analysis, sales information, consumer first party data, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: B02 Audience Insight (insights & research)
rubrics_metrics.description: How deep understanding of the audience/consumers has created a transformative effect on the business.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work that demonstrates the application of behavioural science in relation to building and creating the audience profile. This may include but isn't limited to behavioural economics, consumer insight, social listening, cultural trends, ethnography, experience mapping, neuroscience, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: C01 Challenger Brand Strategy (challenges & breakthroughs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Celebrating brands that have creatively adapted their approach in response to competitor pressure by challenging the status quo to create game-changing work that uses progressive thinking and innovative creativity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The work should demonstrate the core strategic thought and its positive effect on brand value by challenging the dominant narrative conventions in their category.

rubrics_metrics.name: C02 Breakthrough on a Budget (challenges & breakthroughs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Creative use of modest budgets and/or resources in relation to the market and/or industry to create maximum impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The work should demonstrate how fresh insight, smart spending and compelling strategic thinking solved a business problem despite limited resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: C03 Multi-Market Strategy (challenges & breakthroughs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Successful translation and integration of strategy across multiple markets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entrants should demonstrate how a global strategy was applied to specific markets in order to drive tangible business results, or achieve a brand's purpose. Entries should identify a minimum of three countries/regions the strategy was applied to.

rubrics_metrics.name: C04 Long-Term Strategy (challenges & breakthroughs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Celebrating the creativity of long-term strategy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The work should demonstrate how a long-running strategy was instrumental to achieving a brand's purpose, driving engagement and shaping brand identity. There is an increased eligibility for this category of 5 years: 06 February 2021 – 09 April 2026.

rubrics_metrics.name: C05 Corporate Purpose & Social Responsibility (challenges & breakthroughs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Purpose-driven work/brand activism that addresses social, ethical and environmental issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The work should demonstrate how the brand’s purpose has created value and affected communities by connecting customers to culture. All not-for-profit, charity or government work should be entered in the relevant sector and/or A07.

rubrics_metrics.name: C06 Market Disruption (challenges & breakthroughs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Brands that have creatively adapted their strategy in response to local / regional / global issues, embracing new ways of delivering their brand while showing consideration for the consumer.

rubrics_metrics.name: C07 Cultural Engagement (challenges & breakthroughs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Work crafted around strategic solutions rooted in the lived experiences of culturally grounded communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work which reflects and translates the nuances of customs, behaviours, and traditions that shape foundational perspectives on identity (e.g. disability, gender, race, orientation, age). Such insights reveal how audiences choose brands and media experiences, driving growth and impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: D01 Brave Brands (partnerships & perspectives)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rewarding outstanding brand bravery including progressive thinking relating to a brief.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The work should demonstrate risk-taking that produced tangible results for the brand.

rubrics_metrics.name: D02 Collaboration (partnerships & perspectives)
rubrics_metrics.description: Celebrating the intersection between creative agency and/or media and/or brand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The work should demonstrate the focus on the existence of a deep shared understanding of the brand and a unified working relationship to achieve the best possible results.

rubrics_metrics.name: E01 Products/Services (excellence in creative strategy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Integration of a new or developed product/services to solve a problem, evolve the business, enhance the user experience, or grow the customer base.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entrants should give a breakdown of how the product/services was conceived, implemented and provide analysis of its ultimate impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: E02 Experience and Relationship Models (excellence in creative strategy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Creative customer experience initiatives that strengthen relationships with customers by creating seamless journeys across digital and physical touchpoints and/or offer new routes of engagement between brand and consumer.

rubrics_metrics.name: E03 Brand Strategy (excellence in creative strategy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rewarding the core, strategic positioning of a brand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The work should demonstrate how the value proposition, mission, narrative and brand positioning was achieved, and ultimately led to renewed interest, higher brand affinity and commercial success.

rubrics_metrics.name: E04 Retail Media (excellence in creative strategy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Work that strategically harness retailer-owned channels (such as websites, apps and in-store displays) to deliver compelling creative strategies at crucial decision-making moments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Using targeted insights to enhance brand storytelling and drive measurable business outcomes through innovative creative approaches that resonate with shoppers in retail environments.
